historical_signal: The candle-path results remain the reference. They are not an achievable portfolio return.
trigger_definition: Entry is the first tradable minute whose yes bid close is at or above 80 cents after a prior tradable close below 80. A stop is a later tradable minute whose yes bid close is at or below 40 or 65.
live_quote_note: Reacting to a quote inside the minute is a different implementation. Minute candles cannot reproduce it. This collector rejects that trigger.
latency_note: No delay after the close is assumed. Each observation keeps the exchange timestamp and the local receive timestamp. An order is not eligible before that close has been received.
hypothetical_order_intent: After the qualifying minute close is received, record a hypothetical post-only buy YES at 80 cents. That record is not an order and is not sent.
entry_order: Post-only buy YES at 80 cents. Hypothetical only.
entry_note: How long the 80 cent bid may rest, and what cancels its unfilled remainder, are still unresolved. No numeric lifetime is added here.
exit_note: Whether a stop waits for a maker exit or attempts prompt reduction is unresolved. Pricing and fallback rules are not selected. A stop close is only a detection.
market_data: Record quotes, depth, public trades, candle closes, and exchange and receive timestamps. Do not score a fill or a return from those records.
